name: @dahch/huginn
description: CLI/TUI orchestrator for the opencode spec → execute → validate → test → secure → review → doc → commit cycle

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{require('child_process').execSync('bun --version')}catch(e){console.warn('[huginn] Bun is required. Install it from https://bun.sh');process.exit(0)}" && bun run scripts/postinstall.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun test && bun run typecheck
